prompt: Write a Python class LRUCache(capacity) with get(key), which returns the value or None, and put(key, value). When the cache is over capacity it evicts the least recently used key. check.tests:

assert c.get("b") is None
assert c.get("a") == 1 and c.get("c") == 3
c.put("a", 10)
c.put("d", 4)
assert c.get("c") is None
assert c.get("a") == 10 and c.get("d") == 4

c1 = LRUCache(1)
c1.put(1, 1); c1.put(2, 2)
assert c1.get(1) is None and c1.get(2) == 2
big = LRUCache(1000)
for i in range(200000):
    big.put(i, i)
